verdict.rationale: Zep documents RBAC for dashboard users, ABAC policies for API keys and UserGroups to enforce least-privilege access for agents and MCP users, and explicitly states it applies authorization and audit controls to Context Graph operations. This covers roles, policies/ACLs, and auditing as requested, though details on audit log format, retention, and independent verification of audit functionality are thin. Missing for 10: concrete audit-log examples/schema, independent/hands-on validation of governance controls, and finer-grained per-thread/per-document ACL details.
